tasks.title: Migration: nullable password_hash + auth.oauth_accounts table
tasks.description: Idempotent change in server/src/config/migrations/authMigration.ts: ALTER auth.users.password_hash DROP NOT NULL (OAuth-only users have no local password). CREATE TABLE auth.oauth_accounts (id PK, user_id FK auth.users.id, provider VARCHAR(20), provider_user_id VARCHAR(200), email VARCHAR(320), display_name VARCHAR(200), profile_json JSONB, linked_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(), UNIQUE(provider, provider_user_id), INDEX(user_id)).

tasks.title: OAuth state HMAC + provider config helper
tasks.description: Create server/src/services/oauthService.ts with: signState({role, intent, nonce, ts}) → base64url(JSON + HMAC-SHA256 using OAUTH_STATE_SECRET); verifyState(s) returns the parsed payload or throws (rejects state older than 10 min). PROVIDER_CONFIG map for google + linkedin (authorize_url, token_url, userinfo_url, scopes). buildAuthorizeUrl(provider, role, intent, redirectBase). exchangeCode(provider, code, redirectUri) → access token. fetchProfile(provider, accessToken) → {provider_user_id, email, first_name, last_name, display_name, raw}.

tasks.title: Auth service: findOrCreateFromOAuth + linkOAuth
tasks.description: Extend server/src/services/authService.ts with findOrCreateFromOAuth({provider, profile, role, intent}). Logic: 1) lookup auth.oauth_accounts by (provider, provider_user_id) — if found, return its user; 2) else if profile.email matches an existing auth.users row, INSERT oauth_accounts linking it to that user (email already verified by the IDP) and return that user; 3) else if intent='signup', create auth.users (password_hash NULL, role from state, is_email_verified=true) + insert oauth_accounts; 4) else throw NotFound (login attempt without an existing account). Issue the same JWT used by password login.

tasks.title: Auth controller + routes: /oauth/:provider/start and /callback
tasks.description: Add to authController.ts: oauthStart (validates provider + role + intent, returns 302 to provider authorize URL with signed state) and oauthCallback (validates state, exchanges code, fetches profile, calls findOrCreateFromOAuth, redirects to client /oauth/callback?token=<jwt>&role=<role>). Wire routes GET /api/auth/oauth/:provider/start and GET /api/auth/oauth/:provider/callback in authRoutes.ts. Add tests/api_definitions/auth-oauth-*.json definitions.
